jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Guard Full Time Mobile Patrol Driver in Houston, TX to protect clients across cultural and public settings while delivering outstanding customer service.

You will conduct routine vehicle and foot patrols, monitor access points, report incidents, and respond calmly to concerns, coordinating with emergency responders as directed. The role emphasizes teamwork, reliability, and a people-first culture.
